purpose: Recheck the installed Termux graphics stack separately from Ternuxx's saved experimental KGSL candidate.
isolation_method: graphics_manager.verify invoked with an empty private temporary state directory; no saved candidate selection was read; process used DISPLAY=:1 and LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PREFIX/lib.

gles.proof: verification runner could not start; no GLES draw claimed

vulkan.diagnostic: Failed to detect any valid GPUs in the current config
vulkan.proof: device enumeration failed; no draw attempted

limits: This is the current installed Termux package stack on one device, not a clean-install test.

The official Termux Mesa recipe is versioned 26.2.5 and lists Gallium drivers llvmpipe, softpipe, virgl, and zink; it separately enables the Freedreno Vulkan ICD with KGSL support on aarch64. This recipe configuration does not establish a successful Vulkan draw.
The separately selected experimental Mesa 26.3.0-devel KGSL candidate has bounded OpenGL, GLES, and Vulkan draw evidence in the linked recheck, but no stable clean-install distribution path.
No GPU inference or NPU workload was tested.
